newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen rebounding after falls.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen rebounding after falls.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rebound on Friday on the back of Thursday's strong buying after price fixing and stronger performance of several stocks in continuous trade than in the earlier regular session.

Some analysts said, however, the last day of the first subscription period for Bank Handlowy shares now offered at special discounts and Thursday's news that copper giant KGHM goes on sale on June 30 could cool investor mood and trigger falls. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
